answers.core: This is about physics which I think should be in core
answers.workaround: I think it can technically be implemented using scripts but considering there's four different types of `Area2D.gravity_space_override`, it will be hard to calculate, plus, this is just reinventing the wheel, the core can already calculate gravity for `RigidBody2D`, it just needs to expose it to `CharacterBody2D`.

title: Add a gravity property to CharacterBody2D that is calculated with Area2D gravity
